# BenchHub

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SydneyBioX/BenchHub/devel/inst/benchhub_sticker.png)

## Installation instruction

``` r
 devtools::install_github("SydneyBioX/BenchHub")
```

## About

BenchHub is a data storage framework implemented in R language to
facilitate living benchmarks. It aims to enhance reproducibility and
accessibility of benchmarking studies by making it easier to store,
analyse and share benchmarking data.

The three components currently in BenchHub are:  
- **Trio**: A data structure consisting of Dataset, Evidence and Metric
to faciliate the sharing of benchmarking datasets within the
community.  
- **BenchmarkInsight**: A data structure for storing benchmarking
results and provides a collection of visualisations to faciliate the
analysis of benchmarking results. - **BenchmarkInsight**: A data
structure for storing collections of Trio objects and helper functions
for specific benchmarking tasks.

BenchHub aims to make benchmarking easier for multiple groups of users
in the community: - **Benchmark Developers**: BenchHub offers a central
storage for contributing benchmarking studies with the community -
**Method Contributors**: BenchHub allows evaluation of new tools against
established benchmarks in the database without starting from scratch  
- **Benchmark Consumers**: BenchHub allows exploring and interpretation
of results to make informed method selections

### Trio

Trio is built around three key components:

**Data**: Data used by the methods to generate output.  
**Supporting Evidence**: Metadata to compare with the output of methods,
such as cell type, patient outcome, disease pathway.  
**Metric**: Evaluation metrics used to compare output of methods with
supporting evidence.

Trio is implemented as R6 object with fields to store each of the
components.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SydneyBioX/BenchHub/devel/inst/triooverview.png)![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SydneyBioX/BenchHub/devel/inst/triodatastructure.png)

### BenchmarkInsight

BenchmarkInsight serves as a visualisation and analysis tool for
benchmarking results. It contains multiple visualisation techniques to
help researchers analyse benchmarking results in terms of data, methods
and metrics.

Once results are evaluated using Trio, the output can be directly passed
into the benchmarkInsight object. BenchmarkInsight currently supports
the following plot types.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SydneyBioX/BenchHub/devel/inst/benchmarkinsight1.png)![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SydneyBioX/BenchHub/devel/inst/benchmarkinsight2.png)

### BenchmarkStudy

Benchmarking often involve large amount of datasets and processing
scripts. BenchmarkStudy serves as the organisation framework for such
objects. It stores references to collections of Trio objects and helper
functions that standardise method outputs into a common form to
evaluation.

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SydneyBioX/BenchHub/devel/inst/benchmarkStudy.png)

# Package index

## All functions

- [`ARImetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/ARImetric.md)
  : Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) Metric
- [`BenchmarkInsights`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/BenchmarkInsights.md)
  : A BenchmarkInsights object
- [`BenchmarkStudy`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/BenchmarkStudy.md)
  : BenchmarkStudy Class
- [`JSDmetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/JSDmetric.md)
  : Jensen-Shannon Divergence (JSD) Metric
- [`MCCmetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/MCCmetric.md)
  : Matthews Correlation Coefficient (MCC) Metric
- [`MSEmetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/MSEmetric.md)
  : Mean Squared Error (MSE) Metric
- [`NMImetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/NMImetric.md)
  : Normalized Mutual Information (NMI) Metric
- [`RMSEmetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/RMSEmetric.md)
  : Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE) Metric
- [`Trio`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/Trio.md) : A
  Trio object
- [`balAccMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/balAccMetric.md)
  : Balanced Accuracy Metric
- [`balErrMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/balErrMetric.md)
  : Balanced Error Metric
- [`beggCIndexMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/beggCIndexMetric.md)
  : Begg's C-Index Metric
- [`brierScoreMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/brierScoreMetric.md)
  : Brier Score Metric
- [`buildDatasetEvidenceSubmission()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/buildDatasetEvidenceSubmission.md)
  : Build DatasetEvidence submission rows from a Trio object
- [`buildDatasetSubmission()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/buildDatasetSubmission.md)
  : Build a Dataset submission row from a Trio object
- [`buildDatasetTaskMetricSubmission()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/buildDatasetTaskMetricSubmission.md)
  : Build DatasetTaskMetric submission rows from a Trio object
- [`buildDatasetTaskSubmission()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/buildDatasetTaskSubmission.md)
  : Build DatasetTask submission rows from a Trio object
- [`buildMetricSubmission()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/buildMetricSubmission.md)
  : Build Metric submission rows from a Trio object
- [`buildTrioSubmission()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/buildTrioSubmission.md)
  : Build a combined Trio submission object
- [`buildTrioSubmissionPayload()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/buildTrioSubmissionPayload.md)
  : Convert a combined Trio submission to payload structure
- [`collectDatasetSubmissionInfo()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/collectDatasetSubmissionInfo.md)
  : Collect Dataset submission metadata interactively
- [`collectDatasetTaskMetricSubmission()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/collectDatasetTaskMetricSubmission.md)
  : Collect DatasetTaskMetric submission rows from Trio assignments
- [`collectEvidenceSubmissionInfo()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/collectEvidenceSubmissionInfo.md)
  : Collect DatasetEvidence submission metadata interactively
- [`collectMetricSubmissionInfo()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/collectMetricSubmissionInfo.md)
  : Collect Metric submission metadata interactively
- [`collectTaskSubmissionInfo()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/collectTaskSubmissionInfo.md)
  : Collect DatasetTask submission metadata interactively
- [`downloadSubmissionTrio()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/downloadSubmissionTrio.md)
  : Download a Trio from the five-table submission database
- [`ghCIndexMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/ghCIndexMetric.md)
  : GH C-Index Metric
- [`harrelCIndexMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/harrelCIndexMetric.md)
  : Harrel's C-Index Metric
- [`kdeMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/kdeMetric.md)
  : Kernel Density Estimation (KDE) Metric
- [`listCuratedTrioDatasets()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/listCuratedTrioDatasets.md)
  : List the curated Trio datasets
- [`listCuratedTrioStudies()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/listCuratedTrioStudies.md)
  : List the curated Trio studies
- [`lubomski_microbiome_data`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/lubomski_microbiome_data.md)
  [`x`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/lubomski_microbiome_data.md)
  [`lubomPD`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/lubomski_microbiome_data.md)
  : Human Gut Microbiome Abundance and Patient Classes
- [`macroF1Metric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/macroF1Metric.md)
  : Macro F1 Score Metric
- [`macroPrecMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/macroPrecMetric.md)
  : Macro Precision Metric
- [`macroRecMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/macroRecMetric.md)
  : Macro Recall Metric
- [`microF1Metric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/microF1Metric.md)
  : Micro F1 Score Metric
- [`microPrecMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/microPrecMetric.md)
  : Micro Precision Metric
- [`microRecMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/microRecMetric.md)
  : Micro Recall Metric
- [`prepareTrioSubmissionBundle()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/prepareTrioSubmissionBundle.md)
  : Build a pre-submit Trio submission bundle
- [`prepareTrioSubmissionFiles()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/prepareTrioSubmissionFiles.md)
  : Prepare Trio files and download metadata for submission
- [`prepareTrioSubmissionMetrics()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/prepareTrioSubmissionMetrics.md)
  : Prepare Trio metric metadata for submission
- [`submitTrioSubmission()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/submitTrioSubmission.md)
  : Submit a Trio submission payload to Google Apps Script
- [`timeDependentAUCMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/timeDependentAUCMetric.md)
  : Time-Dependent AUC Metric
- [`trioSubmissionToJSON()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/trioSubmissionToJSON.md)
  : Convert a combined Trio submission to JSON
- [`unoCIndexMetric()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/unoCIndexMetric.md)
  : Uno's C-Index Metric
- [`writeSubmission()`](https://sydneybiox.github.io/BenchHub/reference/writeSubmission.md)
  : Interactively prepare a Trio submission bundle
